calibrated_baseline.note: Calibrated low-VU run isolates TRUE app latency below HF free-tier EDGE throttle.

At full 50-VU profile (~410 req/s) HuggingFace's FREE-TIER EDGE rate limiter returns 429 (HF HTML, not app) — the throughput ceiling is HF infra, not a11oy.
